name: oversized arctic monkeys tee
description: an oversized arctic monkeys t-shirt that hangs past your hips like a dress. the sleeves slide down to expose tan shoulders. it smells faintly of jake's jacket from being tied around his waist once. you secretly love that.

params.message: you pull the oversized shirt on. it swallows you, hanging past your hips. the sleeves slip off one shoulder.
soft, faded, and huge on you. the arctic monkeys logo is cracked from washing. the neckline keeps slipping off your shoulders. you feel small in it, but safe.
